concerns.text: SC-002 requires p-value validity to be measured against synthetic uniform/biased datasets, but no task executes any synthetic-dataset validation. The coverage note 'SC-002: verified T015/T016' is unsupported — T015–T022b implement the methods but produce no synthetic-data evidence. Add a task (e.g., extend code/tests/test_stats.py) that runs the test pipeline on a known-uniform and a known-biased synthetic frequency map and records the outcome.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2/3 vs constitution.md:Data Hygiene / Principle V
concerns.text: The constitution requires every file under data/ to be checksummed into state/projects/PROJ-771-...yaml artifact_hashes, and the plan's constitution check claims 'checksums recorded in state YAML', but no task (T100–T106) performs checksumming or state-file updates for the data/raw/ and data/processed/ outputs. Add a checksum/state-update step to T102 (or a small task after it).

concerns.location: tasks.md:T015–T022b vs plan.md:Statistical Methodology item 3 (small-N fallback)
concerns.text: The plan specifies a documented fallback for small N ('if N is too small to form valid blocks, e.g., N < 100, report raw D without a p-value and flag the limitation'), but no task implements or tests this fallback path. T100's N=100 small run will exercise exactly this regime; add the fallback behavior and its verification to the stats tasks or T100.

Batches T010–T014 and T015–T022b are described as 'Preserved as verified' yet are unchecked '- [ ]', and T014 appears in both the checked foundation line and the unchecked T010–T014 batch. Resolve the contradictory completion status so coverage of FR-001/FR-002/FR-003 is unambiguous.

The plan's project structure places tests under tests/unit/ and tests/integration/, but tasks reference code/tests/test_sieve.py and code/tests/test_pipeline.py. The plan element (test tree layout) has no matching task location; align one of the two so the implementer knows where tests live.
